answer: Sponsored entry stops bulk fake identities: each newcomer needs a named sponsor. A sponsor invites five per epoch, locking 30 credits per invitation until one task is finished. If one is proven fake, the bond burns and a ripple review sweeps the sponsor's tree. A relic code cannot be reused: codes bind to the sponsor's key and expire in one epoch. A zephyr-fast burst pays full price: the k-th fake needs a fresh bond, so 1,000 fakes risk 30,000 credits, while honesty costs one refundable bond. Failure mode: invitation rental fails when rented identities share one funder.
